_comment: Gate allowlist for scripts/check-tmp-residue-registry.js. entries[]: {file, match?, reason}. `match` is a substring of the occurrence's source line (omitted = the whole file); line numbers are never used. Every entry needs a reason. Entries with pending_registry:true name a real temp prefix that is not yet in scripts/lib/tmp-residue-registry.json (it is the only registration source); they are temporary and move into the registry. A whole-repo scan reports entries that match no occurrence (allowlist_stale).
